questions.text: Which list will win the most seats in the 26th Knesset?
questions.resolution: List with the most seats in the final CEC results. A tie is broken by valid votes.

questions.text: Will Yashar win more seats than any other list?
questions.resolution: Same resolution as largest_list. Consistency pair with largest_list.

questions.text: Which list will come second in seats?
questions.resolution: Second-largest list by seats, ties broken by valid votes.

questions.text: Which list will come third in seats?
questions.resolution: Third-largest list by seats, ties broken by valid votes.

questions.text: Will Likud win fewer than 32 seats, its 2022 total?
questions.resolution: Likud seats in the final CEC results are 31 or fewer. Consistency pair with seats_likud.

questions.text: Will the Netanyahu bloc (Likud, Shas, United Torah Judaism, Otzma Yehudit, Religious Zionist Party – Zehut, Noam) win 61 or more seats combined?
questions.resolution: Sum of seats for Likud, Shas, United Torah Judaism, Otzma Yehudit, Religious Zionist Party – Zehut, Noam in the final CEC results is at least 61.

questions.text: Will the Zionist opposition lists (Yashar, Together (B'Yachad), The Democrats, Yisrael Beiteinu, The Reservists and the Economic Party, Amcha Yisrael) win 61 or more seats combined, without the Arab lists?
questions.resolution: Sum of seats for Yashar, Together (B'Yachad), The Democrats, Yisrael Beiteinu, The Reservists and the Economic Party, Amcha Yisrael is at least 61.

questions.text: Will neither the Netanyahu bloc nor the Zionist opposition reach 61 seats on its own?
questions.resolution: Both netanyahu_bloc_61 and opposition_zionist_61 resolve false.

questions.text: Which bloc will win more seats?
questions.resolution: Compare the Netanyahu bloc's seats with the Zionist opposition's seats, as defined above.
